nodes.text: Is there a sequence $1\leq d_1<d_2<\cdots$ with density $1$ such that all products $\prod_{u\leq i\leq v}d_i$ are distinct?

#421 : [ErGr80,p.84] number theory A construction of Selfridge (see [786] ) shows that there exists such a sequence of density $>1/e-\epsilon$ for any $\epsilon>0$. See also [786] .
